summary.text: Chris McDaniel is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 23, serving since 2013. The legislature's profile lists McDaniel as chair of the Senate Appropriations & Revenue Committee. His profile name is Christian McDaniel.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Christian McDaniel is the owner of McD Concrete.
The profile lists a B.S. from The Citadel, an M.B.A. from Northern Kentucky University, and Army service from 1997 to 2001.

It also lists membership in several construction and builder associations, including the American Society of Concrete Contractors and the Northern Kentucky Home Builders Association, and a term as president of Leadership Northern Kentucky.
